ValidationRule.description: If Renewal is blocked then Reason should be given.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(Renew_Application__c = true, ISBLANK(Reason__c)), AND(PRIORVALUE(Renew_Application__c) = true, Renew_Application__c = false, NOT(ISCHANGED(Reason__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the reason for Blocking/Unblocking 'Renewal Application'!
